cohort: 71 female patients who had undergone planned Caesarean section, without postoperative complications, and developed scars.
finding: No statistical differences were found between the subgroups regarding the genotype (TGF-β1 and COL5A2 single nucleotide variants) and pathological scarring, as all included patients were wild-Type allele carriers.
cross-section timing: After developing scars following Caesarean section
